title: Information Aggregation and Social Networks: Responsiveness and Overturning
abstract: arXiv:2607.28921v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies how network structure affects information aggregation in social learning. Agents sequentially choose actions based on private signals and observations of neighbors' actions. Comparing a focal agent' s expected payoff across networks at a finite period, we show that a network is uniquely optimal for some informational environment if and only if the focal agent observes every predecessor. This characterization reveals that which network performs best depends critically on the informational environment. We then revisit two important implications of the characterization through transparent constructions: the star network can uniquely outperform every alternative under binary signals, while the complete network can do so with richer signals. translated_title: 信息聚合与社会网络：响应性与颠覆效应
translated_abstract: 本文研究网络结构如何影响社会学习中的信息聚合。智能体基于私人信号以及对邻居行为的观察，依次选择行动。通过在有限时期内比较焦点智能体在不同网络中的预期收益，我们证明：当且仅当焦点智能体能够观察到所有前序者时，该网络在某种信息环境下才是唯一最优的。这一刻画揭示了哪个网络表现最佳关键取决于信息环境。我们随后通过透明的构造重新审视了该刻画的两个重要推论：在二元信号下，星型网络可以唯一地优于所有其他网络；而在更丰富的信号下，完全网络则可以做到这一点。这些构造凸显了响应性效应与颠覆效应之间的权衡：稀疏网络通过保留响应性来促进信息聚合。
tldr: 本文刻画了社会学习中唯一最优网络的充要条件——焦点智能体须观察到所有前序者，并据此证明星型网络在二元信号下、完全网络在丰富信号下可分别唯一最优，其背后是响应性效应与颠覆效应之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes uniquely optimal networks in social learning—requiring the focal agent to observe all predecessors—and shows that the star network can uniquely dominate under binary signals while the complete network dominates with richer signals, highlighting a trade-off between the responsiveness and overturning effects.
